full_judgment: 6. It is further stated that it will appear from the register that on 7.3.2000 no notice of the meeting, either regular or emergent was issued to other directors. But for this purpose the dispatch register was tampered with by inserting new entries and allocating number to the so called meeting dated 14-3-2000. A comparison of the document regularly used by the CCCI would reveal the forgery and interpolation by the applicants. Copies of the previous attendance sheets which are used by the CCCI showing attendance of the directors and a copy of the attendance sheet which is fabricated to use as evidence of service of notice are annexed as Annexures-1, 2 and 3 to the affidavit-in-opposition on behalf of the petitioner against the application for addition of party dated 25.5.2000.
